# CWE-798: Private key — -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- / RSA PRIVATE KEY.
# Private keys must never be checked in. The rule flags those PEM
# headers; ok is CERTIFICATE or non-key text.
# ruleid: detected-private-key
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEogIBAAKCAQEAjosMtDUqbE1/8zxZac1t8fkh2SxGuMXHk9yxniyM2m76donW
# ruleid: detected-private-key
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEogIBAAKCAQEAjosMtDUqbE1/8zxZac1t8fkh2SxGuMXHk9yxniyM2m76donW
# ok: detected-private-key
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIEogIBAAKCAQEAjosMtDUqbE1/8zxZac1t8fkh2SxGuMXHk9yxniyM2m76donW
# ok: detected-private-key
not a key
